ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green cubes of firm fruit or vegetable flesh, roughly 2-3 cm pieces with cut faces, smooth matte skin edges, slightly translucent pale flesh, a few small dark seeds scattered among them, clustered on the upper left part of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green wild leafy greens with ruffled, frilly edges, some stems, glossy wet sheen with light dressing, loosely piled across the right and center of the plate, scattered with small dark specks and a few pale green pieces | 75
ITEM 3 | Thin, bright green slender beans, about 6-8 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, glossy and slightly oily, some with pale tips, laid in a diagonal bundle across the lower left of the plate alongside the leafy greens | 65
ITEM 4 | Small dark brown-black seeds or berries, about 0.5-1 cm, glossy and smooth, a few scattered near the fruit cubes and among the greens | 5
ITEM 5 | Tiny reddish-brown bits, irregular flakes about 0.2-0.5 cm, dry and matte, scattered sparsely over the plate near the beans and greens | 2
ITEM 6 | Light sheen of clear oily dressing coating the greens and beans, visible as glossy wet patches on the leaves and on the plate surface | 8
